# School of Motion

> > Online motion design education platform offering professional courses in After Effects, Cinema 4D, and creative animation techniques.

School of Motion, founded by Joey Korenman, provides comprehensive training for motion designers through structured courses like AE Kickstart and C4D Basecamp, alongside tutorials, podcasts, and industry insights. The platform covers everything from Adobe After Effects fundamentals to advanced 3D workflows with Cinema 4D, Blender, and emerging tools.

## Key Topics

- After Effects
- Cinema 4D
- Motion Design
- 3D Animation
- Joey Korenman
- Character Animation
- Expressions
- Mograph
- Adobe Photoshop & Illustrator
- Blender
- Procreate
- C4D Basecamp
- AE Kickstart
- Freelancing
- Creative Process

## Courses & Learning Paths

- [School of Motion | Explore our Motion Design Course Catalogue](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/courses): Main course catalog featuring After Effects, Cinema 4D, and Unreal courses
- [Learn Photoshop + Illustrator | School of Motion Learning Path](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/learning-paths/learn-photoshop-illustrator): Learning path for mastering Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator fundamentals
- [A Wild, Bug-Filled World of 3D | A School of Motion Course](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/courses/a-wild-bug-filled-world-of-3d): Advanced 3D mixed media course by Doug Alberts featuring film production

## After Effects Tutorials

- [After Effects 101: Basic Keyframe Types](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/after-effects-keyframe-types): After Effects tutorial on keyframe types and interpolation basics
- [Everything About Expressions You Didn't Know...Part Deux: Semicolon's Revenge](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/everything-expressions-you-didnt-know-part-2): After Effects expressions tutorial covering lights, cameras, and text
- [What is the After Effects Disk Cache](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/after-effects-disk-cache): After Effects disk cache optimization guide for workflow performance

## Cinema 4D & 3D Workflows

- [Cinema 4D & After Effects Workflows](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/cinema-4d-to-after-effects): Workflow guide for integrating Cinema 4D with After Effects projects
- [Create Multi-Dimensional 3D Typography in Cinema 4D](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/3d-typography-cinema-4d): Cinema 4D tutorial on creating advanced multi-dimensional 3D typography
- [Cinema 4D R20: Highlighting the New Features](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/cinema4d-r20-new-features-highlight): Cinema 4D R20 new features overview including Volume Builder and Fields

## Character Design & Animation

- [Getting Started with 2D and 3D Character Design and Animation](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/getting-started-2d-3d-character-design-animation): Beginner guide to character design, rigging, and animation techniques
- [A Guide to Free Brushes in Procreate](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/a-guide-to-free-brushes-in-procreate): Guide to finding and installing free brushes in Procreate for iPad

## Industry Insights & Interviews

- [Crypto Art - Fame and Fortune, with Mike "Beeple" Winkelmann](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/crypto-art-fame-and-fortune-mike-winkelmann-beeple): Podcast interview with Beeple on NFT crypto art and digital artwork
- [How to Build a Tutorial Empire Like Ben Marriott](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/ben-marriott): Ben Marriott interview on YouTube tutorials, freelancing, and AI
- [Be A Better Freelancer, Right Now](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/be-a-better-freelancer-right-now): Podcast with Joey Korenman on freelance tips and client management
- [Getting Unstuck: A Total Project Walkthrough](https://www.schoolofmotion.com/blog/getting-unstuck-total-project-walkthrough): Creative collaboration walkthrough by Jon Riedell and Sofie Lee
